title: Proposition A
subtitle: City of Jersey Village Fire Control, Prevention, and Emergency Medical Services District — 20-Year Renewal
summary: Proposition A asks voters whether to continue the existing fire control, prevention, and emergency medical services district for 20 years, and whether the district's 0.5% sales tax should also be continued for 20 years. This is a special joint election with the City of Jersey Village.
details: This is a renewal of the existing district and its 0.5% sales tax, not a new tax.
The 0.5% district sales tax replaced a prior 0.5% property tax relief sales tax.
The district currently funds fire protection and emergency medical services, including 12 full-time firefighters.
Approval continues current fire and EMS service levels for an additional 20 years.
forArguments: Maintains current fire and emergency response capabilities without interruption.
No increase in the existing tax rate — this renews the current arrangement.
Ensures continued professional fire and EMS coverage, including 12 full-time firefighters.
The district sales tax funds are dedicated solely to fire and emergency services.
againstArguments: Commits the city to a 20-year term with limited ability to renegotiate.
Some residents prefer shorter renewal periods for more frequent public review.
Long-term commitments reduce flexibility to explore alternative service models, such as contracting with neighboring fire departments.
Locks in a 0.5% sales tax rate for two decades regardless of future fiscal conditions.
